title: Resource Arguments and Tags
scenario: Resources are blocks with a type and a name. Complete an S3 bucket so the bucket name comes from a variable and the resource carries a Project tag.
constraints: Add a tags map with Project = "arena".

focus.title: Complete the bucket resource
focus.todo: Set the bucket argument and add the Project tag.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked TODO in `main.tf`. Set the bucket argument and add the Project tag. Use the visible constraints as your checklist before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work inside the single TODO region. Change one requirement at a time: add the named block, argument or reference, then run the tests. When a check fails, match its wording to the constraints and fix only the block it names.
